properties.description: An open decision is owed only once somebody has been ASKED to settle it (crates/reflow2-core/tests/report.rs, 5 cases): a proposed Decision alone is silent; adding AUTHORED_BY role=author is still silent, because recording whose idea it is says nothing about who owes an answer; role=approver makes it owed and names it in `next`; settling it clears the debt. The author-is-not-an-approver case is the one that matters — without it every attributed brainstorm becomes a nag, which is the deliberate quiet this was built not to break.
properties.name: An open decision is owed only once somebody has been asked to settle it
